plan.title: Block mixed service and material PR purchase

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions screen, the required starting point for a PR-based event.
Use the Open tab because only open requisitions can be selected for purchase.
Select two line items from one PR as the closest available representation of the service and material selection.
Verify that Purchase Items is disabled for the selected lines.

args.text: Services and Materials cannot be purchased together

steps.note: Verify the disabled control shows the expected explanation.
Try the disabled Purchase Items control and require evidence that the action is refused.
